slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
quietly unshakeable

taking the stairs slowly

walk up every flight of stairs at a calm, even pace this week, even when you're late. a body that refuses to rush teaches the mind that it's never under threat.

eating at the counter

sit at the bar or counter of a busy cafe instead of hiding at a corner table. being seen while you're relaxed is training for every other room you walk into.

learning on the bus

use one bus or train ride a day to learn something in 5 minutes: the history of your city, a famous building. knowing your world makes you steady in it.
slides.texte_sophia:
learning on the bus

i use one bus ride a day to learn something in 5 minutes, like the history of my city. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and knowing my world made me steady in it.

slides.texte_overlay:
holding the door

hold the door and say one real sentence to the person, not just a nod. ten tiny conversations a week rebuild the social muscles that screens slowly weakened.

three good mornings

say good morning to three people you pass every day for a week. it costs nothing, and the world becomes surprisingly warm once you're the one who starts it first.
